3.0.0-beta4.goal: Expand Blockfrost compatibility with broader network coverage and production-grade asset behaviour.

outcomes.title: Broader Blockfrost network coverage
outcomes.description: Applications can access Blockfrost-compatible network information through Yaci Store, expanding the API surface available without changing providers.

outcomes.title: Reliable asset responses at scale
outcomes.description: Asset history, holder, and policy results match Blockfrost ordering and burn semantics while remaining responsive for high-activity assets and large policies.
